blocks.text: Compound lipids fatty acids ke aise alcohols ke saath esters hain jin mein koi izafi (additional) group bhi ho, jaise phosphate, nitrogen wala base, carbohydrate ya protein. Phospholipid fat molecule jaisa hota hai, lekin is mein glycerol se teen ki bajaye sirf do fatty acids jure hote hain. Glycerol ka teesra hydroxyl group phosphate group se jura hota hai, jo molecule ko polar (charge ke lihaz se do siron wala) bana deta hai. Hydrocarbon dumein (tails) hydrophobic hain, jab ke phosphate group aur us se jure hisse aik hydrophilic (paani pasand) sar (head) banate hain jo paani ki taraf khinchta hai (Figure 27.11).

Jab phospholipids paani mein dale jayen to yeh dohri teh wali chadar banate hain jise 'bilayer' kehte hain. Polar sire bahar (paani ki taraf) rehte hain aur non-polar sire andar aapas mein apni alag teh mein ikatthe ho jate hain. Tamam cell membranes ki banawat yahi hai. Kuch liposomes masnooi (artificial) phospholipids hain jo paani mein ghulne wali (hydrophilic) dawaiyan pohanchane ke liye use hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: phospholipid ka gol hydrophilic (paani pasand) sar aur do hydrophobic (paani se door) dumein. Daen: block diagram jis mein glycerol aik fatty acid, doosre fatty acid, aur phosphate (PO4) se jura hai jo aik alcohol se juri hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.11: Phospholipids ki bunyadi banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono hisse aik hi molecule hain: block diagram ke do fatty acids hi do hydrophobic dumein hain, aur glycerol se juri PO₄ aur alcohol hydrophilic sar hain. Paani mein yeh molecules dumein andar aur sar bahar kar ke bilayer banate hain.
Lipoproteins lipids aur proteins ke complexes hain jo hydrophobic lipids (jaise cholesterol aur triglycerides) ko khoon (bloodstream) mein aik jagah se doosri jagah le jate hain.
Glycolipids woh lipids hain jin se carbohydrate (sugar) groups jure hon; yeh zyada tar nervous tissue (asaab ke tissue) mein milte hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Liposomes paani pasand (hydrophilic) cancer ki dawaiyan pohanchane ke liye behtareen hain. In ki banawat aisi hai ke lipid bilayer andar ke paani wale hisse (watery core) ko gher leti hai; is core mein paani mein ghulne wali dawa band ho jati hai, tootne se bachi rehti hai aur cell ke andar aasani se dakhil hoti hai. Liposomes dawa ki solubility barhate hain aur use seedha rasoli (tumor) ke cells tak pohanchate hain.

blocks.alt: Liposome: aik gola jis ki deewar lipid bilayer hai, laal sar bahar ke paani aur andar ke aabi markaz ki taraf aur dumein darmiyan mein. Hare hydrophilic dawa ke zarre aabi markaz (aqueous core) mein; neele lipophilic dawa ke zarre bilayer ke andar. Labels: aqueous core, lipidic bilayer, hydrophilic drug, lipophilic drug.
blocks.caption: Liposome (kitab ke Did You Know box ki liposome tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Phospholipids paani mein bilayer kyun banate hain?
blocks.explanation: Har molecule ka sar hydrophilic (polar) aur dumein hydrophobic (non-polar) hain; paani mein sar dono taraf paani ki taraf rehte hain aur dumein dohri teh ke andar paani se chhupi rehti hain.

items: Compound lipids mein izafi group hota hai (phosphate, base, carbohydrate, protein).
Phospholipid: polar sar, do non-polar dumein; paani mein bilayer, yahi cell membrane hai.
Lipoproteins khoon mein lipids le jate hain; glycolipids nervous tissue mein.
